title: MLAG Peer BGP Password Mismatch — dc1-leaf1a iBGP to leaf1b drops
symptom: MLAG peer-link is Up and negotiation is Connected, but inter-MLAG iBGP session (10.255.1.97) is stuck in Active. VRF route synchronization between dc1-leaf1a and dc1-leaf1b broken.
root_cause: MLAG-IPv4-UNDERLAY-PEER password changed to wrong value on dc1-leaf1a — iBGP MD5 auth mismatch with dc1-leaf1b
